name: Beverly Wilshire, A Four Seasons Hotel
positioning: Hotel on Wilshire Boulevard at the foot of Rodeo Drive in Beverly Hills, open since 1928
best_for: Travelers who want to stay steps from Rodeo Drive
Guests who want a Wolfgang Puck steak and seafood restaurant on site

facts.text: The hotel is on Wilshire Boulevard at the foot of Rodeo Drive in the heart of Beverly Hills.
The hotel has 395 rooms in total.
The design aesthetic is Italian Renaissance style with French neo-classic influences.
Arrival is via El Camino Real, a cobblestone driveway lined with gaslight lanterns imported from a castle in Edinburgh.
Beverly Wilshire has been managed by Four Seasons since 1992.
CUT by Wolfgang Puck serves a steak and seafood menu.
THE Blvd has a patio overlooking Rodeo Drive.
The hotel has one Mediterranean-style pool with cabanas and lounge chairs available.

highlights.text: The hotel is located just steps away from Rodeo Drive.
CUT by Wolfgang Puck in Beverly Hills is the flagship location of the Michelin-recommended restaurant.
The Spa at Beverly Wilshire has an ice fountain.
The spa's Experience Shower has three settings: Cold Mist, Caribbean Rain and Atlantic Storm.
The hotel offers complimentary transportation in a house car to any destination within a 2.5-mile radius of the Hotel.

considerations.text: The complimentary house car is available on a first-come, first-served basis.
The hotel is approximately 30 to 40 minutes by car from Los Angeles International Airport.
WhataHotel notes ultra-luxury pricing that reflects the premium Beverly Hills location.

perks.text: With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, breakfast for two is free daily.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get a priority upgrade if available at check-in.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get a $100 hotel credit.
WhataHotel special offers can be combined with the exclusive perks.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get free Wi-Fi access.
